concepts.gloss_en: Malkhut/kingship — the sefirah of Kingship, bechinat dalet, the letters of speech
Halakhot — laws/legal rulings studied by Torah scholars

notes: Not the same concept at all. The mechanical pass grouped these on the shared surface pattern (ל-כ-ו-ת ending), but מלכות (root מ-ל-ך, Kingship/sefirah) and הלכות (root ה-ל-כ, laws) are entirely different lexemes with unrelated referents. The ה in הלכות is a root letter, not a definite-article clitic. Kept fully separate.
